annotations.title: Watch the end of a fixed energy price (e-mail before it ends)

description: A household gives its e-mail and the last day of its fixed electricity or gas price (fixation_end YYYY-MM-DD, today to 5 years ahead); optionally the distributor area, today's supplier (supplier_id from energy_suppliers) or product (current_offer_id from compare_energy products) and the consumption. Double opt-in: the e-mail first gets a confirmation link and nothing else is sent before the person clicks it (an agent cannot confirm for the person). A confirmed watch gets one e-mail 45 days before the end with the offers cheaper for its need (from the official price lists; an estimate). Every mail has a cancel link. Unconfirmed watches are deleted after 7 days, every watch 30 days after its end date. No account, no contract, no commission. At most 5 watches per e-mail. Ask the person for consent before passing their e-mail.

distributor.description: cez-distribuce | egd | pre-distribuce | gasnet | gas-distribution | ppd: without it the alert is a reminder without prices.

email.description: The person's e-mail (they confirm it themselves).

fixation_end.description: Last day of the fixed price, YYYY-MM-DD.

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the visitor's address with a daily salt (the website computes it).

locale.description: Language of the e-mails: cs | sk | en.

mwh.description: Yearly consumption MWh (high tariff or all).
